correctness.rationale: A scalar comparison at (v,v) forces N(V) inside V for any characteristic; (1,1) forces \(Tu=\alpha u\); direct basis pairs prove sufficiency. originality.rationale: Full historical texts of Cariñena–Grabowski–Marmo (2000; arXiv posting 2006) and Uchino (2007/2009), modern all-3D-complex classification (Zou et al., arXiv 2308.12121), and related enhanced adjoint-action work were compared by implication. value.rationale: The problem asks for an intrinsic solution variety and full orbit sizes of a natural associative Nijenhuis identity across a uniform infinite family. The operator-count formula and all-field all-rank orbit series are exact reusable invariants and strengthen finite low-dimensional parametrizations; the result is not a routine numeric extension or arbitrary slice.
